Updates the top-level `version:` field in `pubspec.yaml` for Dart and Flutter projects, with configurable Flutter `+build` suffix strategies (`none`, `increment`, or `release-count`).

## Installation

### Binary

```bash
semrel plugin install @semrel/updater-pubspec
```

`semrel plugin install` downloads the binary to `.semrel/plugins/` and updates `.semrel.lock`. Commit `.semrel.lock` to pin the version for your team.

### Docker

Pre-built, signed multi-platform images (`linux/amd64`, `linux/arm64`) are published on every release:

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/semrels/updater-pubspec:latest
```

Verify the image signature with cosign:

```bash
cosign verify ghcr.io/semrels/updater-pubspec:latest \
  --certificate-identity-regexp 'https://github.com/SemRels/updater-pubspec/.github/workflows/release.yml.*' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
```

## Configuration

```yaml
version: 1
plugins:
  - uses: @semrel/updater-pubspec
    phase: pre-tag
    args:
      pubspec_path: pubspec.yaml
      pubspec_build_strategy: increment
```

## Environment Variables

| Name | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_PUBSPEC_PATH` | no | `./pubspec.yaml` | Path to the `pubspec.yaml` file to update. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_PUBSPEC_BUILD_STRATEGY` | no | `none` | Build suffix strategy: `none`, `increment`, or `release-count`. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_PUBSPEC_BUILD_NUMBER` | no | `—` | Explicit build number override (`<semver>+<number>`). |

## Release Context Variables

- `SEMREL_VERSION`
- `SEMREL_NEXT_VERSION`
- `SEMREL_DRY_RUN`
- `SEMREL_RELEASE_COUNT`
- `SEMREL_BUILD_NUMBER`

## Behavior

The plugin performs a surgical line-based update of the top-level `version:` key so comments, indentation, and dependency blocks remain untouched:

- **`none` (default):** Writes bare SemVer (e.g. `version: 1.5.0`).
- **`increment`:** Increments the existing `+build` suffix (e.g. `1.4.0+42` → `1.5.0+43`), starting at `+1` if none exists.
- **`release-count`:** Uses `SEMREL_PLUGIN_PUBSPEC_BUILD_NUMBER`, `SEMREL_RELEASE_COUNT`, or `SEMREL_BUILD_NUMBER` (falling back to `existing + 1`).
